configuration_assertions.literal_interpretation: The API Gateway method is configured without API Gateway authorization.
The Lambda data role is attached to a policy containing an allow for all DynamoDB actions on all resources.
The frozen module declares the blog-users DynamoDB table.

cases.entry: registered web-application user invoking a file/URL fetch function
mandatory_claims: web input can read the Lambda execution environment
recovered Lambda credentials can enumerate and scan blog-users
the same credentials can write an item to blog-users
validation_plan: resolve the exact Lambda role, DynamoDB table ARN, actions, boundaries, and resource policies from deployed state
run complete-scope AWS policy analysis for ListTables, Scan, and PutItem
in an isolated account, probe the three operations and retain CloudTrail records

configuration_assertions.literal_interpretation: The ECS task uses ecs-task-role and that role is attached to AWS SecretsManagerReadWrite.

cases.entry: low-privilege application workflow with an unrestricted manager-side file upload
mandatory_claims: uploaded server-side code reaches the ECS task environment
the task credential endpoint releases the ECS task-role credentials
the task role can list secrets and retrieve RDS_CREDS
validation_plan: separate Secrets Manager credential exposure from unproven database access
analyze the task role against the exact secret ARN
probe GetSecretValue and retain CloudTrail; do not claim an RDS data read without a database query record

configuration_assertions.literal_interpretation: The same frozen module declares an Azure Cosmos DB account and Azure Storage account.

mandatory_claims: SSRF/local-file access retrieves local.settings.json
the retrieved Cosmos DB connection string permits record modification
the retrieved Storage connection string permits blob or source-code download

data_target.service: Azure Cosmos DB and Azure Blob Storage

validation_plan: capture the deployed Function configuration and storage/Cosmos account state
query Azure RBAC/Defender attack-path evidence where applicable
probe one scoped Cosmos item update and one scoped blob download, retaining Azure activity/data-plane logs

configuration_assertions.literal_interpretation: The production container grants anonymous blob access but does not configure anonymous container listing.
The development container grants anonymous container and blob access.

mandatory_claims: production container anonymous list is denied
development container anonymous list succeeds
development container anonymous blob read succeeds
cases.upstream_expected_outcome: paired negative production state and positive development state
validation_plan: freeze both container access configurations from the same deployment
issue identical unauthenticated list probes to production and development containers
retain the explicit production denial, development success, and storage logs as a paired certificate

configuration_assertions.literal_interpretation: The production bucket custom role gives allUsers object read when an object name is known, but not object listing.
The development bucket gives allUsers object read plus bucket IAM read/write, but not initial object listing.

mandatory_claims: initial production and development object-list operations are denied
development allUsers can read and set the bucket IAM policy
after the policy mutation, anonymous object listing succeeds
validation_plan: save pre-mutation and post-mutation IAM policies as distinct frozen states
run Policy Analyzer and testIamPermissions for the exact allUsers principal and bucket
retain the initial denied list, policy change audit record, and final successful list

configuration_assertions.literal_interpretation: The RDS resource requests public accessibility, while its attached database security-group ingress is scoped to the VPC CIDR rather than 0.0.0.0/0.
The EC2 user-data template renders the RDS endpoint, username, and password into a local PHP database configuration and uses them for a MySQL connection.

cases.entry: principal that can read the rendered EC2 user-data or host-side database configuration
mandatory_claims: the exact deployed principal can retrieve the rendered database configuration
the source host is permitted through the effective RDS network path on TCP 3306
the rendered credentials authenticate and an authorized test query succeeds
cases.upstream_expected_outcome: candidate only; no upstream end-to-end path outcome is adopted as gold
validation_plan: resolve the deployed RDS address, subnet routes, security groups, NACLs, source host, and database principal
do not treat publicly_accessible=true as proof of internet or host reachability
in an isolated account, test the exact source-to-RDS connection and a non-destructive SELECT while retaining VPC and database audit evidence

configuration_assertions.literal_interpretation: The Azure MySQL resource enables its public network surface and disables mandatory SSL, but the file alone does not prove an effective firewall rule or authenticated data access.

mandatory_claims: the deployed server receives a public endpoint
the complete effective firewall and network scope permits the external probe source
a separately authorized database principal can authenticate and execute a scoped read
cases.upstream_expected_outcome: candidate only; public_network_access_enabled is not adopted as end-to-end reachability gold
validation_plan: resolve the deployed endpoint and all Azure MySQL firewall and networking rules
use a complete-scope network oracle before assigning Reachable or NotReachable
in an isolated subscription, retain an explicit connection success or denial and a separately authorized non-destructive query record

configuration_assertions.literal_interpretation: The frozen GCP stack binds allUsers to roles/storage.objectViewer on the declared bucket; effective permissions and deployed runtime behavior still require provider-native and active verification.

mandatory_claims: the binding is effective on the exact deployed bucket without a higher-level constraint or conflicting state
anonymous object listing succeeds
anonymous read of a designated non-sensitive test object succeeds
cases.upstream_expected_outcome: candidate only; the IaC binding is not adopted as runtime gold
validation_plan: save the exact deployed bucket IAM policy and organization-policy context
run Policy Analyzer and testIamPermissions for allUsers over list and get
probe anonymous list and read only against a designated non-sensitive object and retain Cloud Audit Logs where available

configuration_assertions.literal_interpretation: The frozen challenge declares DT_flag and attaches a policy permitting GetSecretValue on that exact secret to the double_tap_secret EC2 role.

The starting-user trust, Lambda create/invoke and constrained PassRole permissions, and a Lambda role with tag-conditioned EC2 actions are all present; these literals do not by themselves prove the complete exploit chain.

cases.entry: the CloudFoxable ctf-starting-user identity in an isolated deployed challenge
mandatory_claims: the starting identity can assume the intended challenge role under both trust and identity-side policy evaluation
the Lambda PassRole and tag-conditioned EC2 steps can reach an instance path associated with the secret-reading role
the resulting principal can retrieve only the designated DT_flag test secret and the access is recorded in CloudTrail
cases.upstream_expected_outcome: candidate only; the challenge objective is not adopted as end-to-end path gold
validation_plan: deploy the pinned challenge in an isolated AWS account and freeze the exact principal, role, instance, tag, and secret ARNs
evaluate every hop with complete-scope AWS policy simulation and Access Analyzer evidence, including trust policies, identity policies, boundaries, SCPs, and resource conditions
execute the authorized challenge path with a designated test secret and retain positive or explicit denied responses plus matching CloudTrail records

configuration_assertions.literal_interpretation: The Elasticsearch domain resource policy permits three HTTP actions to any principal only when the request source matches the configured single-IP CIDR.
The frozen challenge includes a deployment-time provisioner that targets the domain endpoint and attempts to seed webserver-log test documents.

cases.entry: unauthenticated client at the exact configured user_ip source address
mandatory_claims: the deployed Elasticsearch endpoint is network-reachable from the exact configured source IP
an unauthenticated request from that source satisfies the effective resource policy for the intended HTTP action
a scoped read retrieves a designated seeded test document while an otherwise identical out-of-scope source receives an explicit denial or cannot reach the endpoint
cases.upstream_expected_outcome: candidate only; the challenge statement is not adopted as public reachability or data-access gold
validation_plan: deploy the pinned challenge in an isolated AWS account and freeze the exact endpoint, resource policy, configured source IP, DNS resolution, and network state
run complete-scope policy analysis for the anonymous request context and retain the evaluated SourceIp condition
perform paired authorized probes from the configured and an out-of-scope source against a non-sensitive seeded test document, retaining response and service audit evidence
